audit.whatIsWrong: Two abilities were attributed to the wrong slots and one name is fabricated outright. The page tracks "Personal Space (Fear)" as the fear — Personal Space is her W, a 475-range shield with AoE damage on 16/15/14/13/12s, and it does not fear. The fear and the dash-interrupt come from Doom 'n Gloom (P). The content layer also calls her ultimate "Doom Bolt" in seven places; her R is Shadow Surge (140/120/100s, 2000/2500/3000 range): a missile that marks a champion and is recast to dash to them. spikes[0].text calls Personal Space her passive, and early credits Gloom stacks to W when Gloom comes from Looming Darkness (E).
audit.why: Riot's passive text: "Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes." That is the single interaction that defines this lane for Azir, because Shifting Sands is a dash — and the page had it pinned to the wrong ability, so a player would watch the wrong cooldown.
audit.corrected: The fear moved to Doom 'n Gloom throughout, Shadow Surge replaces "Doom Bolt", Gloom credited to Looming Darkness, and Personal Space described as the shield it is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed across layers: phases[2] and [3] read "Skill" against win "Vex"; phases[4] read "Vex" against win "Azir"; phases[5] and [6] read "Skill" against win "Azir". phases[4].why described Azir winning every 2v2 on a row the full layer gave to Vex.
audit.why: Packet levelChart (Vex x4, then Azir, Azir, Azir) matches the content layer row for row: her passive taxes his only escape pre-6, and Emperor's Divide is what flips it.
audit.corrected: All five sides aligned to the content layer, with phases[2].why and phases[3].why rewritten to argue for Vex on those stages.

audit.why: Spike timing holds: her pressure is levels 1-5, Azir's flip is level 6 into Nashor's. Shadow Surge dropping to 100s at rank 3 and reaching 3000 units is why she stays a pick threat after lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and named the wrong ability as the thing to track.
audit.why: Mistral Bolt is 8/7/6/5/4s at 1200 range — the constant chip. Looming Darkness is a flat 12s. Personal Space is 16s at rank 1 and is her only self-peel, so baiting it is the real trade window. Doom 'n Gloom has no fixed cooldown to count; you read the glow.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rebuilt around the glow plus the three real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten fields called Vex "he/his/him" (lint MISGENDER); dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists vex as female; the templates were written for a male enemy.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bleed bullets rewritten to their titles.

notes: This matchup carried the worst ability errors in my slice. "Doom Bolt" is not a Vex ability at all — her R is Shadow Surge — and it appeared in seven places across the content layer. The fear was also pinned to the wrong ability everywhere: the page tracked "Personal Space (Fear)", but Personal Space is her W (a 475-range shield) and the fear plus the dash-interrupt come from Doom 'n Gloom (P). A player following the old page would have been watching a 16-second shield cooldown while the thing that actually punishes Shifting Sands is a passive you read off the glow. focus.text is only 25 characters, so if apply-proposals.js skips strings under 25 characters the new value (24 chars) may be refused — if it is, that field still needs the same change by hand. report[1].t, report[3].t, report[4].t and report[11].t also carry misgendered pronouns; they are verbatim copies of winCon, tradeGood/tradeBad, breakdown.wave and the donts titles, all fixed above, so they only need the same swap if report[] is not regenerated from those sources. phases[2..6].side were aligned to win[2..6], which already held the correct values on disk, so no paired content edit exists to propose.
